reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 93550, which is on the recalled models list.
The purchase was at ALDI, a listed retailer, on 2017-11-24, which is inside the 2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31 sale window. No receipt is required for this claim.
The destruction photo shows the unplugged power cord cut, as the recall requires.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
The $40.00 refund is below the $100.00 review threshold, so no person review is required.
